_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 7 — bản phủ tiếng Anh (ban biên tập, chờ người bản xứ duyệt).

source.ten: Reference edition (AI draft, 2026) in the Balliett–Jordan tradition and popular numerology books
source.luu_y: Draft text, shown under the project owner's decision; reviewed gradually. A cultural reference, not a forecast.

gap_go.cau_hoi: Do you have a meeting, a negotiation or an interview today?

hoc_tap.cau_hoi: Are you planning to study, revise for an exam or read today?

tinh_cam.cau_hoi: Do you have a date, or want to talk with someone you love today?

gia_dinh.cau_hoi: Any chores today, or time for your parents or kids?

chi_tieu.cau_hoi: Are you planning a big purchase or sorting out your money today?

van_dong.cau_hoi: Are you planning to work out or get moving today?

bat_dau.cau_hoi: Do you want to kick off a new task or project today?

di_chuyen.cau_hoi: Do you have a long trip or a move today?

nghi_ngoi.cau_hoi: Do you want to rest and look after yourself today?

sang_tao.cau_hoi: Are you planning to write, draw, make content or think up ideas today?

ngay_pho_quat.1: The general mood of the day is beginning: many people want to start something new and speak their mind.
ngay_pho_quat.2: The general mood of the day is cooperation: good for listening, giving way and working in pairs.
ngay_pho_quat.3: The general mood of the day is communication: people chat, share and open up more easily.
ngay_pho_quat.4: The general mood of the day is routine: good for hard work, getting organised and keeping commitments.
ngay_pho_quat.5: The general mood of the day is movement: lots of small changes, good for staying flexible and trying new things.
ngay_pho_quat.6: The general mood of the day is care: good for looking after family, community and shared responsibilities.
ngay_pho_quat.7: The general mood of the day is stillness: good for reflection, careful research and a slower pace.
ngay_pho_quat.8: The general mood of the day is practical: good for business talks, organising and clear decisions.
ngay_pho_quat.9: The general mood of the day is closing: good for finishing, forgiving and giving.

1: Where today do you want to be the one who speaks first?
If you took just one first step towards what you have been hoping for, what would it be?
What do you want to decide for yourself today without waiting for anyone?
Which of your ideas deserves to be said out loud today?
2: Who do you want to listen to a little more closely today?
Which task would feel lighter if someone did it with you?
Who could you thank for working well with you lately?
In today's conversations, what would you like to ask instead of assert?
3: What story do you want to share with someone today?
Which idea do you want to sketch out on paper today?
Who would you like to send a cheerful hello to?
What could make you and the person next to you laugh together today?
4: Which small task, if finished today, would make the whole week lighter?
Which corner of your home or your computer do you want to tidy today?
Which habit do you want to keep up today?
How will you plan today so you still have room to breathe?
5: Which habit would you like to do differently today?
Is there a place near home you have never visited and would like to try?
If today's plan changes, what do you want to hold on to?
What new thing would you like to learn for just a few minutes?
6: Which relative would be glad to hear from you today?
How do you want to look after yourself today?
Which promise do you want to keep today?
What small thing could make your living space more comfortable?
7: Which question do you want to give careful thought to today?
Where and when do you want a quiet moment today?
Which book or topic do you want to dig deeper into?
What do you want to understand better before you decide?
8: Which decision do you already have enough information to make today?
Which part of your money do you want to sort out clearly today?
Which task do you want to hand to someone else so you can focus on the main thing?
Which goal do you want to write down with a number and a deadline?
9: What do you want to close so there is room for something new?
Which object or task are you willing to let go of today?
Who do you want to say thank you or sorry to?
Which unfinished task do you want to finish today?

bat_dau.nhan: A good day to open the show
bat_dau.cach_lam: Pick exactly one new task and take the first step before noon: send the email, set up the folder, make the opening call.
bat_dau.tu_soi: Did you take the first step of your new task before your lunch break today?

cong_viec.nhan: Step up for the main piece of work
cong_viec.cach_lam: Ask to take the part you want to lead and set out your approach in a few short sentences, instead of waiting to be assigned.
cong_viec.tu_soi: Did you volunteer for a piece of work in today's meeting?

gap_go.cach_lam: Prepare an opening line that says clearly what you want from the meeting, then say it in the first few minutes.
gap_go.tu_soi: In today's meeting, did you state your main wish right at the start?

sang_tao.cach_lam: Write three rough ideas in fifteen minutes without judging them, then pick one to sketch further.
sang_tao.tu_soi: Did you note down a new idea today before talking yourself out of it?

van_dong.cach_lam: Swap one familiar exercise for one you have never done, at a manageable intensity so you still want to train tomorrow.
van_dong.tu_soi: Did you try a new move or route in today's workout?

hoc_tap.nhan: Learn the basics of a new topic
hoc_tap.cach_lam: Good for opening a new topic: read the overview, list your questions, and leave the deep dive for the coming days.
hoc_tap.tu_soi: Did you write down the questions you want answered before you started reading?

di_chuyen.nhan: Set off with a clear schedule
di_chuyen.cach_lam: Decide your own route and timing before you leave, and let the people who need to know with a short message.
di_chuyen.tu_soi: Before setting off, did you settle your route and tell the people who need to know?

chi_tieu.cach_lam: Write down the maximum for the purchase before you go shopping, then decide quickly within that limit.
chi_tieu.tu_soi: Did you set a spending limit before opening your wallet today?

gia_dinh.nhan: Take charge of one job at home
gia_dinh.cach_lam: Take on a household job people usually have to remind you about, finish it fully, then say it is done.
gia_dinh.tu_soi: Did you do a household job today before anyone had to remind you?

tinh_cam.nhan: Lead, but leave room for them
tinh_cam.cach_lam: The day has a take-charge rhythm, so when you suggest plans for a date offer two options to choose together, rather than deciding alone.
tinh_cam.tu_soi: When you asked your partner out today, did you let them help choose?

nghi_ngoi.nhan: Rest with a purpose of your own
nghi_ngoi.cach_lam: The day leans towards action, so turn your break into something you choose and schedule, like a solo walk or a few pages of a book.
nghi_ngoi.tu_soi: Did you pick a specific way to rest instead of scrolling your phone to pass the time?

tinh_cam.nhan: A good day to listen to each other
tinh_cam.cach_lam: Have a conversation that is only for asking and listening, and repeat back what your partner just said before giving your view.
tinh_cam.tu_soi: Did you repeat back what your partner said before replying today?

gia_dinh.cach_lam: Ask everyone at home which part they would like to take, divide the work that way, and do one small job together.
gia_dinh.tu_soi: Did you ask your family which part they wanted before dividing the chores?

gap_go.cach_lam: Open the meeting by asking about the other side's concerns, note two things you both want, then move on to the differences.
gap_go.tu_soi: In the meeting, what common ground did you find before discussing anything else?

nghi_ngoi.cach_lam: Pick a quiet way to rest, like a longer bath, soft music or a cup of tea, and turn off notifications while you do it.
nghi_ngoi.tu_soi: Did you turn off notifications while resting today?

hoc_tap.cach_lam: Good for a study group or asking someone more experienced: bring two specific questions and write down how they explain things.
hoc_tap.tu_soi: Did you ask someone a specific question about what you are learning today?

cong_viec.cach_lam: Help a colleague where they are stuck, or review where your work and the team's work meet.
cong_viec.tu_soi: Did you ask a colleague where they needed help before diving into your own work?

sang_tao.cach_lam: Good for polishing something you already have or asking for feedback on a draft; write the feedback down before responding.
sang_tao.tu_soi: Did you note down other people's feedback before explaining your own view?

di_chuyen.nhan: Travel with someone for an easier trip
di_chuyen.cach_lam: If you are travelling, ask someone to come along or ask a contact at your destination to show you around, and keep the schedule relaxed.
di_chuyen.tu_soi: Did you leave spare time in today's schedule so you did not have to rush?

van_dong.cach_lam: Good for training in pairs or groups, or for steady-rhythm exercise like walking, slow swimming or stretching.
van_dong.tu_soi: Did you invite someone to move with you today?

bat_dau.cach_lam: The day leans towards cooperation, so the first step of a new task can be a talk with the people involved to hear their thoughts before you dive in.
bat_dau.tu_soi: Before starting the new task, did you ask the people you will work with for their views?

chi_tieu.nhan: Talk it over with whoever shares the cost
chi_tieu.cach_lam: For a big purchase, discuss it with the person who will use it or chip in, write down what you both agree, then buy.
chi_tieu.tu_soi: Is there someone involved in today's purchase whose view you have already asked?

sang_tao.nhan: A good day for ideas to flow
sang_tao.cach_lam: Write, draw or film a quick draft in one sitting, getting all the ideas out first and polishing later.
sang_tao.tu_soi: Did you finish a complete draft today, however rough?

gap_go.cach_lam: Bring a short story that illustrates your point to make the meeting feel friendlier.
gap_go.tu_soi: In today's meeting, did you use a concrete example to help the other person picture it?

tinh_cam.nhan: Say the kind things out loud
tinh_cam.cach_lam: Give your partner a specific compliment or share a happy memory, in words rather than just an emoji.
tinh_cam.tu_soi: Did you say out loud one thing you value about your partner today?

hoc_tap.cach_lam: After reading, try explaining it to someone else or record yourself; where you stumble is where you need to study more.
hoc_tap.tu_soi: Did you explain what you just learned to someone, or to yourself?

van_dong.cach_lam: Pick a fun way to move, like dancing to music, playing ball with friends or cycling around town.
van_dong.tu_soi: Was there a moment in today's workout that made you laugh?

cong_viec.cach_lam: Good for presentations, reports or updates; keep each message to three points so it does not ramble.
cong_viec.tu_soi: Did the update you sent today fit into three main points?

bat_dau.cach_lam: Begin the new task by telling a few people about it, and note the questions they ask so you know what needs clarifying.
bat_dau.tu_soi: Who did you tell about the new task, and did you note their questions?

di_chuyen.nhan: Travel to meet people and see places
di_chuyen.cach_lam: If you are travelling, leave a gap in the schedule to stop somewhere new or chat with locals.
di_chuyen.tu_soi: On the road today, did you stop somewhere or learn something new from someone?

gia_dinh.cach_lam: Make the meal a time for stories: everyone shares one good thing from their day, little ones included.
gia_dinh.tu_soi: At today's meal, did you ask everyone about one good thing in their day?

nghi_ngoi.cach_lam: Rest in a light-hearted way, like a comedy, a call to an old friend or some colouring, as long as it makes you happy.
nghi_ngoi.tu_soi: Did today's break actually make you feel lighter?

chi_tieu.cach_lam: A high-spirited day makes impulse buying easy, so write a list first and leave anything off the list in the basket until tomorrow.
chi_tieu.tu_soi: Was what you bought today on the list you wrote beforehand?

cong_viec.cach_lam: Pick the two longest-standing tasks and finish them one at a time, closing unrelated tabs while you work.
cong_viec.tu_soi: Which backlog task did you fully close today?

hoc_tap.cach_lam: Split what you need to learn into small blocks with start and end times, and tick each block off when done.
hoc_tap.tu_soi: Did you study in the time blocks you set for today?

chi_tieu.cach_lam: Good for reviewing this month's spending, cancelling a subscription you do not use and setting a budget for next week.
chi_tieu.tu_soi: Did you find a recurring cost you no longer need today?

van_dong.cach_lam: Do the session you planned and note your sets or distance so you can compare with yourself next time.
van_dong.tu_soi: Did you record today's workout so you can track it?

gia_dinh.nhan: Sort out a corner of the home
gia_dinh.cach_lam: Choose one drawer, a kitchen corner or a child's wardrobe to tidy with your family, done in one session.
gia_dinh.tu_soi: Which corner of your home got properly tidied today?

bat_dau.nhan: Lay the foundation for something new
bat_dau.cach_lam: If you are starting something new, spend the day building the frame: a task list, milestones and what you need to prepare.
bat_dau.tu_soi: Does your new task have a list of steps and milestones yet?

gap_go.cach_lam: Bring documents and checked figures, and write down what needs to be agreed by the end.
gap_go.tu_soi: At the end of today's meeting, did you sum up what was agreed?

nghi_ngoi.nhan: Rest at the time you set
nghi_ngoi.cach_lam: Put a specific break in your calendar like an appointment, and stop when it comes even if the work is unfinished.
nghi_ngoi.tu_soi: Did you stop work at the break time you set?

tinh_cam.cach_lam: Do something practical for your partner, like fixing something, cooking their favourite dish or handling some paperwork for them.
tinh_cam.tu_soi: Did you do one specific thing to help your partner today?

di_chuyen.cach_lam: The day suits routine more than spontaneity, so before the trip list your things, documents and times so it runs smoothly.
di_chuyen.tu_soi: Did you check your documents and things to bring before setting off?

sang_tao.nhan: Create in a fixed time slot
sang_tao.cach_lam: Ideas may come more slowly on a disciplined day, so sit down in a fixed time slot and work on the technical side, like tightening sentences or the layout.
sang_tao.tu_soi: Did you sit through your planned creative slot today even before the ideas came?

di_chuyen.nhan: A good day to hit the road
di_chuyen.cach_lam: Choose a different stretch of road or stop from last time, so your eyes and mind get refreshed.
di_chuyen.tu_soi: On today's trip, did you try a new route or a new stop?

bat_dau.cach_lam: Start the new task as a small trial of a few hours, see the response, then decide whether to carry on.
bat_dau.tu_soi: Did you make a small trial version instead of planning for too long?

van_dong.cach_lam: Swap your usual routine for something completely different, like hill walking, swimming or a team sport.
van_dong.tu_soi: Did you move in a different way from usual today?

sang_tao.nhan: Mix in ideas from unfamiliar places
sang_tao.cach_lam: Read or watch something outside your field, then bring one detail from it into what you are working on.
sang_tao.tu_soi: Did you borrow an idea from another field for today's creative work?

gap_go.cach_lam: Prepare two or three alternatives so the meeting has room to move when the other side makes an unexpected offer.
gap_go.tu_soi: Did you bring alternatives into today's meeting?

tinh_cam.nhan: Try a fresh kind of date
tinh_cam.cach_lam: Swap the usual spot for somewhere neither of you has been, or try cooking something new together.
tinh_cam.tu_soi: Was there anything new on today's date that you had not done together before?

hoc_tap.cach_lam: Alternate reading, videos and hands-on practice in short stretches to keep your focus.
hoc_tap.tu_soi: Did you switch how you were studying when you noticed your attention slipping today?

cong_viec.cach_lam: When plans change, rewrite your priority list in five minutes and carry on, rather than sticking to the old schedule.
cong_viec.tu_soi: When something came up today, did you reorder your priorities?

nghi_ngoi.cach_lam: Change scenery to rest: go to a park, a new cafe, or walk around an unfamiliar neighbourhood.
nghi_ngoi.tu_soi: Did you change your seat or surroundings to unwind today?

chi_tieu.nhan: If the urge to buy hits, wait
chi_tieu.cach_lam: The day is full of appetite for the new, so for big items write down the name and price and look again after a night's sleep; if you still need it, buy it.
chi_tieu.tu_soi: For today's big item, did you sleep on it before deciding?

gia_dinh.nhan: A change of air for the family
gia_dinh.cach_lam: A restless day can make chores feel cramped, so turn housework into something new, like cooking an unusual dish together or taking the family for a walk.
gia_dinh.tu_soi: Did you invite your family to do something new together today?

gia_dinh.nhan: A good day to care for family
gia_dinh.cach_lam: Call your parents to check in, or spend a block of phone-free time with your kids.
gia_dinh.tu_soi: Did you give your family a block of undivided time today?

tinh_cam.cach_lam: Notice a small need of your partner's, like a glass of water or a check-in message when they are busy, and do it without being asked.
tinh_cam.tu_soi: Did you do something small for your partner without waiting to be asked?

nghi_ngoi.cach_lam: Cook yourself a proper meal, go to bed earlier, or make your resting corner more comfortable.
nghi_ngoi.tu_soi: Did you do something caring for yourself today, as you would for someone you love?

sang_tao.cach_lam: Good for making something to give or for brightening your home: arrange some flowers, write a card, rearrange your desk.
sang_tao.tu_soi: Did you make something small to give someone or to brighten your space today?

cong_viec.cach_lam: Prioritise the tasks other people are waiting on you for, finish them and let them know.
cong_viec.tu_soi: Was someone waiting on your work, and did you send it today?

gap_go.nhan: Listen to what the other side needs
gap_go.cach_lam: In a meeting or interview, ask what the other side needs to solve and say clearly which part you can help with.
gap_go.tu_soi: Did you ask what the other side needed before presenting what you offer?

hoc_tap.cach_lam: Choose to learn something you can use right away for family or your team, like a cooking skill or a basic first-aid tip.
hoc_tap.tu_soi: Did what you learned today help anyone in particular?

van_dong.cach_lam: Invite your family for a walk after dinner or play outside with your kids, keeping to the pace of the least energetic person.
van_dong.tu_soi: Did you get moving with a family member for a while today?

chi_tieu.cach_lam: Good for spending on the home and family; ask whoever will use it before choosing.
chi_tieu.tu_soi: For what you bought for the home today, did you ask the people who will use it?

bat_dau.cach_lam: The day is heavy with responsibility, so before starting anything new check the promises still open and give notice if you need to move them.
bat_dau.tu_soi: Before taking on something new, did you review the promises still open?

di_chuyen.nhan: Travel, but remember those at home
di_chuyen.cach_lam: The day turns towards family, so if you have to travel, sort things at home first and set a time to call back.
di_chuyen.tu_soi: Before the trip, did you sort things at home and set a time to keep in touch?

hoc_tap.nhan: A good day for deep study
hoc_tap.cach_lam: Choose one topic and read one good source closely in a long uninterrupted stretch, taking notes in your own words.
hoc_tap.tu_soi: Did you study in one long stretch today without opening social media?

nghi_ngoi.cach_lam: Give yourself some screen-free time alone: a walk, sitting still, a few lines in a journal.
nghi_ngoi.tu_soi: Did you have some truly alone time today?

sang_tao.cach_lam: Good for mulling over a big idea: write down the core question and answer it in a few careful paragraphs.
sang_tao.tu_soi: Did you spend time going deep on one idea instead of jumping between many?

van_dong.cach_lam: Good for yoga, stretching, walking alone or slow swimming, the kind of exercise that settles the mind.
van_dong.tu_soi: Did today's movement help your mind settle?

tinh_cam.cach_lam: A gentle time together, like reading side by side, a quiet walk, or telling each other what is on your mind.
tinh_cam.tu_soi: Did you share with your partner what you are really thinking about today?

gia_dinh.nhan: A deep talk with one person
gia_dinh.cach_lam: Instead of juggling chores, sit and talk longer with one family member about what is on their mind.
gia_dinh.tu_soi: Did you ask a family member in depth about what is worrying them today?

cong_viec.nhan: Do the work that needs analysis
cong_viec.cach_lam: Prioritise work that needs careful thought, like checking data, tracing the cause of an error or writing a proposal; move meetings to another day if you can.
cong_viec.tu_soi: Did you make time today for the work that needs the most careful thought?

di_chuyen.cach_lam: If you are travelling, bring a notebook or a book and use the journey to think rather than just scroll.
di_chuyen.tu_soi: On the road today, did you note down a thought worth keeping?

gap_go.cach_lam: The day turns inward, so prepare the questions you want answered, speak little and listen closely, and ask for time to think before agreeing.
gap_go.tu_soi: In today's meeting, did you ask for time to think before agreeing on something important?

chi_tieu.cach_lam: The day suits research more than quick action, so compare, read reviews and write down why you need it, then decide once it is clear.
chi_tieu.tu_soi: Did you write down why you need the item before buying it?

bat_dau.cach_lam: The first step of a new task today can be reading up and writing down the questions to answer, leaving the action for days with a more outward rhythm.
bat_dau.tu_soi: Have you written down the questions your new task needs to answer?

cong_viec.nhan: A good day to settle big matters
cong_viec.cach_lam: Make the decision that has been hanging, assign work with clear owners and deadlines, and put the decision in writing.
cong_viec.tu_soi: Did you make a decision today that had been hanging for a while?

gap_go.cach_lam: State the figure or terms you want during the meeting, with a short reason, and ask clearly for the other side's terms.
gap_go.tu_soi: In the negotiation, did you state the terms you want clearly?

chi_tieu.cach_lam: Good for budgeting, splitting money into categories, paying bills that are due and noting your total income and spending.
chi_tieu.tu_soi: Do you know your total income and spending for this month today?

bat_dau.cach_lam: Begin the new task with a measurable goal, a person responsible and a first checkpoint.
bat_dau.tu_soi: Does your new task have a measurable goal and a first checkpoint?

hoc_tap.nhan: Learn something you can use right away
hoc_tap.cach_lam: Choose a skill that directly serves your work or personal finances, and practise applying it right after learning.
hoc_tap.tu_soi: Did you apply what you learned today to something real right away?

van_dong.cach_lam: Set a small target for the session, like one more set or holding the pace longer, and record the result.
van_dong.tu_soi: Did you set and hit a small target in today's workout?

di_chuyen.cach_lam: Combine several errands into one trip, book tickets and accommodation in advance, and keep receipts for expenses.
di_chuyen.tu_soi: Did you fit several errands into today's trip?

gia_dinh.cach_lam: Hold a quick family meeting to split the week's chores and agree on shared spending.
gia_dinh.tu_soi: Has the whole family agreed who does what this week?

sang_tao.nhan: Turn an idea into a plan
sang_tao.cach_lam: Take an idea you already have and write the steps to make it a finished product, with a deadline for the first step.
sang_tao.tu_soi: Does your favourite idea have a next step and a deadline yet?

nghi_ngoi.cach_lam: It is a day of many decisions, so schedule short breaks between the big ones and treat them as part of your working day.
nghi_ngoi.tu_soi: Did you schedule breaks between the big tasks today?

tinh_cam.nhan: Leave work at the door when you are together
tinh_cam.cach_lam: The day is focused on practical matters, so when you meet your partner, switch off work talk and ask about their day.
tinh_cam.tu_soi: When you were with your partner today, did you put work talk aside?

nghi_ngoi.nhan: A good day to let go
nghi_ngoi.cach_lam: Cross one task you no longer need off your list and use that space to rest properly.
nghi_ngoi.tu_soi: Which task that no longer matters did you cross off today?

gia_dinh.cach_lam: Say the thank-you or apology you still owe someone at home, or clear out old things to give away.
gia_dinh.tu_soi: Is there a thank-you or an apology to your family that you said out loud today?

sang_tao.cach_lam: Pick a half-finished draft and complete it, accepting it is not perfect so you can close it.
sang_tao.tu_soi: Did you finish a creative piece that had been left half done today?

tinh_cam.cach_lam: Recall something good your partner once did and let go of a small issue still sitting between you.
tinh_cam.tu_soi: Did you let go of a small issue with your partner today?

cong_viec.cach_lam: Prioritise wrapping up projects, writing handover notes and summing up what you learned before taking on new work.
cong_viec.tu_soi: Did you write down your takeaways from the finished task before moving on?

hoc_tap.cach_lam: Good for reviewing a whole chapter you have studied, summarising it on one page and noting the gaps.
hoc_tap.tu_soi: Did you sum up what you learned on one page today?

gap_go.cach_lam: Use the meeting to settle the remaining open points, send a short summary afterwards and thank the other side.
gap_go.tu_soi: After the meeting, did you send a summary and a thank-you to the other side?

van_dong.cach_lam: Choose gentle exercise that helps you unwind, like a long walk, stretching or deep breathing at the end of the day.
van_dong.tu_soi: Did you feel more relaxed after today's movement?

di_chuyen.cach_lam: If you are moving or travelling far, take the chance to get rid of things you do not use and pack light.
di_chuyen.tu_soi: Did you get rid of anything you no longer use before leaving?

bat_dau.cach_lam: The day leans towards closing, so use it to finish old work and list what the new task needs, leaving the kickoff for the next day.
bat_dau.tu_soi: Did you close an old task to make room for the new one?

chi_tieu.cach_lam: The day suits giving more than buying, so pay off a small debt, sell what you do not use, and note any big purchase to think about tomorrow.
chi_tieu.tu_soi: Did you pay off or clear something still outstanding today?
